author: Zephyr I
title: Wide synergy: 64/128 CNN + double-step LN-ConvLSTM(48) + AttnPool — ratio ∈ {0.4,0.45,0.5}
abstract: Test Krono-style wide CNN (64/128) with compute-preserving bottleneck ratios for our double-step LN-ConvLSTM(48) + AttnPool backbone (d=5). Goal: recover ≥37k updates and surpass 79.5.
